description: macOS 12 to 15 client SYN over Ethernet or Wi-Fi (MSS 1460)

provenance.notes: From public p0f / JA4T signatures for macOS: TTL 64, DF, window 65535, options MSS,NOP,WS,NOP,NOP,TS,SACK_PERM,EOL (padded to 24 bytes), WS 6. Whether recent macOS sets ECE+CWR on the SYN (ecn) is not confirmed. Re-capture on our own Macs with `lb-fptest tcp-capture` and set status to captured.
